briefing: NASDAQ +1.6% and S&P 500 +0.7% signal a risk-on day, and ZS shows a fully confirmed bullish setup (MACD crossover, RSI in the bullish zone, price above SMA-20, and volume surge), but with only $389.29 in cash we're below the threshold needed to add a meaningful position. Holding cash and existing positions rather than forcing an undersized buy.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Even on a strong market day with attractive setups, a portfolio should only deploy cash when the position size would be meaningful — buying a tiny sliver of a stock with leftover cash usually isn't worth the transaction complexity or risk. It's often better to wait until enough capital has built up to make a full-sized, properly diversified position.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 即使在大市造好、出現吸引買入機會的日子，投資組合亦只應在資金足以建立有意義倉位時才出手——用剩餘的少量現金買入極少股數，通常不值得承擔相關的交易複雜性和風險。較穩妥的做法是待累積足夠資金後，才建立規模適當、分散得宜的倉位。

market_education.summary_en: Markets pushed higher today with the NASDAQ leading gains at +1.6% and the S&P 500 up +0.7%, reflecting broad risk-on sentiment across sectors. Momentum names like ZS showed particularly strong technical confirmation with a volume-backed breakout above key moving averages. Without specific news headlines available today, the move appears driven by continued buying momentum rather than a single catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市造好，納斯達克指數領漲，升幅達1.6%，標普500指數亦上升0.7%，反映市場整體風險偏好升溫。個別強勢股如ZS錄得成交量配合的技術性突破，股價站穩主要均線之上。由於今日未有特定新聞頭條可供參考，是次升勢似乎主要由持續的買盤動力帶動，而非單一事件觸發。
